description: A painted scene of a tall modern brick church with a large leaded glass wall, joined at its side to a roofless Gothic stone ruin with pointed windows. In the foreground a black cross stands on a stone plinth amid rubble, with a low stone wall at the lower left. A procession of robed clergy and a line of people in mid-century dress stand near the modern entrance under a dark, stormy sky with a shaft of light falling on the ruin.
